fullDescription: A bold, dark-mode design system with a high-contrast orange accent, combining editorial serif typography with industrial surrealism. Suitable for fintech, blockchain, construction, or high-end architectural platforms. Characterized by grainy noise overlays, floating surrealist 3D/photographic elements, and scroll-triggered parallax effects using cubic-bezier easing.
prompt:
## Resumo
A high-impact dark aesthetic featuring a near-black base (#050505), vibrant orange accents (#FF4500), and a mix of elegant Playfair Display serif headings and minimalist Inter body text. The layout uses floating layered imagery and asymmetric card patterns with smooth reveal animations.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a dark background #050505. Primary accent color is #FF4500. Secondary text color is #ffe0e0 with varying opacities. Typography: Headlines in 'Playfair Display' (weights 400-700), Body in 'Inter' (weights 300-500). Apply a global noise overlay using a grain SVG at 0.05 opacity with mix-blend-mode: overlay. All interactions should use cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Buttons should have rounded-full corners. Headlines should have a subtle text-glow (0 0 12px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.3)) when in orange. Use a grid background pattern with 1px radial dots of #FF4500 spaced 60px apart at 5% opacity for section backgrounds.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Sticky header transition. Starts transparent with 32px vertical padding. On scroll, transition to #050505/95 background with backdrop-blur-md, 16px padding, and a 1px border-bottom in white/5. Logo on left in Playfair Display, nav links centered in small-caps Inter, and a pill-shaped CTA button on the right (#FF4500).

### Hero Section
Center-aligned content over a multi-layered background. Layer 1: Atmospheric image at 40% opacity. Layer 2: Floating surrealist elements (left and right) with infinite floating animations (y-axis +/- 20px). Layer 3: Main headline in Playfair Display (size 72px) with italics for emphasis. Subtitle in Inter (18px) at 90% opacity. Bottom element: A digital clock and location label in monospace font (10px) with uppercase tracking-widest.

### Mission/Trust Section
Large editorial focus. Headline text-size 60px, serif, center-aligned. Followed by a 4-column logo grid of partner brands, styled in grayscale with 40% opacity, transitioning to 100% on hover. Spacing: 128px top/bottom padding.

### Feature Cards
Asymmetric 2-column grid. Left card starts at baseline. Right card is offset vertically by 96px. Cards are aspect ratio 4:5. Card 1: Solid #FF4500 background, black text, top-right 'number' badge. Card 2: Dark #111 background, white text, 1px border white/10. Implement scroll-parallax: left card moves down slightly on scroll, right card moves up.

### Footer
Minimalist but high-scale. Features a giant watermark-style logo (text-size 10vw) at 5% opacity. Content includes a horizontal list of links in uppercase tracking-widest (12px) and a secondary technical metadata row (coordinates/timestamp) in monospace font.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Floating Surrealist Imagery — Layered photographic assets that move independently of the content.
Place high-quality isolated photographic assets (e.g., hands, tools) with mix-blend-hard-light and 60% opacity. Apply CSS keyframe animations for 'float-left' (12s) and 'float-right' (14s) using slight rotation (2deg) and vertical movement (20px).

### The Glass Dashboard Button — Secondary CTA with subtle blur and glow.
A pill-shaped container with border-white/20, background-white/5, and backdrop-blur-sm. Inside, text is 12px uppercase tracking-widest. On hover, increase background-white/10 and trigger a centered #FF4500/20 blur-xl glow effect behind the button.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the noise overlay throughout for the industrial texture. MUST use italics in Playfair Display for 'accent' words in headlines to achieve the editorial look. DO NOT use standard ease-in-out; only use the specified cubic-bezier for a premium feel. MUST use a mix of serif and sans-serif to balance traditional trust with modern tech.

Typography pairs an elegant serif (Playfair Display) for headlines—often featuring italics for specific keywords—with a clean sans-serif (Inter) for functional text. Accent color is #FF4500, used for primary CTAs and highlights. Animations are smooth and sophisticated, utilizing a cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) curve for reveals and parallax offsets.
